name: OrderVIATriage
title: Order VIA Triage After Positive HPV
description: Activity template for ordering Visual Inspection with Acetic acid (VIA) as the triage step after a positive HPV DNA result, per WHO Algorithm 5. Instantiated by the CervicalCancerTriage PlanDefinition when triage is indicated.
purpose: Provide a canonical template for the act of ordering a VIA examination as triage following a positive HPV result, suitable for the proposal phase of the FHIR CPG Activity Flow.

relatedArtifact.display: WHO Rec 8 (general population) / Rec 28 (WLHIV): VIA as triage following positive HPV in the screen-triage-and-treat approach
